title: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSIONING OF HONORARY MAYORS AND COUNTY HEADS FOR THE FIVE NORTHERN PROVINCES AND UNRECOVERED CITIES AND COUNTIES

REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSIONING OF HONORARY MAYORS AND COUNTY HEADS FOR THE FIVE NORTHERN PROVINCES AND UNRECOVERED CITIES AND COUNTIES

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to establish honorary Mayors and heads of Gun, etc. for the Five Northern Provinces and unrecovered Si and Gun, thereby clearly affirming that the unrecovered regions remain national territory and promoting the will for reunification through restoration of the lost lands. <Amended on August 19, 2015; and January 5, 2021.>

Article 2 (Commissioning)
(1) Honorary Mayors and heads of Gun shall be commissioned for the Five Northern Provinces and unrecovered Si and Gun under Article 2 of the Special Measures Act on the Five Northern Provinces, Etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Five Northern Provinces, etc.") on the basis of the Si and Gun administrative units existing as at August 15, 1945; they shall hold honorary positions symbolically representing the relevant Si or Gun. <Amended on August 19, 2015.>
(2) Honorary Mayors and heads of Gun shall be commissioned by the President of the Republic of Korea through the Prime Minister, upon nomination by the Minister of the Interior and Safety based on recommendations by the Governors of the Five Northern Provinces, from among persons originating from or having connections with the relevant Si or Gun of the Five Northern Provinces, etc. who possess learning and good reputation and are dedicated to reunification: Provided, That candidates for honorary Mayor or head of Gun of unrecovered Si and Gun shall be recommended by the Chairperson of the Committee for the Five Northern Provinces under Article 7 of the Act and Article 4 of the Regulations on the Committee for the Five Northern Provinces (hereinafter referred to as the "Chairperson"), after hearing the opinions of the Governor of Gyeonggi-do and the Governor of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; August 19, 2015; July 26, 2017; and June 4, 2024.>
(3) Where the position of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun becomes vacant, the Governor (meaning the Chairperson in the case of unrecovered Si or Gun; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall recommend a successor to the Minister of the Interior and Safety without delay: Provided, That the Governor may refrain from recommending a successor where less than six months remain in the predecessor's term. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; August 19, 2015; and July 26, 2017.>

Article 3 (Term of Office)
(1) The term of office of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun shall be three years, and the person may be reappointed only once: Provided, That this restriction shall not apply where two or more reappointments are unavoidable due to special regional circumstances or similar reasons.
(2) Notwithstanding the main clause of paragraph (1), the term of office of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun newly commissioned to fill a vacancy shall be the remainder of the predecessor's term.

Article 4 (Disqualifications)
(1) No person falling under any subparagraph of Article 33 of the State Public Officials Act, or any person affiliated with a political party, may be commissioned as an honorary Mayor or head of Gun.
(2) Where an honorary Mayor or head of Gun comes to fall under a disqualification specified in paragraph (1), the person shall automatically be dismissed from the commission.

Article 5 (Duties)
An honorary Mayor or head of Gun shall, under the direction of the Governor, perform the following duties: <Amended on August 19, 2015.>
1. Cooperating with government policies and administrative affairs concerning the Five Northern Provinces, etc.;
2. Maintaining contact and coordination between the Five Northern Provinces, etc. and residents of the northern Si and Gun who came to the South;
3. Providing support to, and managing matters concerning, those residents and related organizations;
4. Providing assistance including family-bonding arrangements between North Korean defectors and residents of the northern Si and Gun who came to the South;
5. Fostering and supporting the succeeding generations of those residents;
6. Inheriting and developing traditional local culture peculiar to the northern Si and Gun;
7. Fostering liberal democracy and enhancing security awareness among those residents;
8. Other matters necessary for administering affairs for those residents.

Article 6 (Honorary Heads of Dong, etc.)
(1) Honorary heads of Dong and Ri shall be appointed for Dong and Ri of Si in the Five Northern Provinces, etc., and honorary heads of Eup and Myeon may be appointed for Eup and Myeon of Gun. <Amended on August 19, 2015.>
(2) Honorary heads of Dong, Ri, Eup and Myeon shall be commissioned for the Dong, Ri, Eup and Myeon administrative units of the Five Northern Provinces, etc. as they existed on August 15, 1945, and shall hold honorary positions: Provided, That an honorary head of Dong or Ri may be commissioned to represent two or more Dong or Ri consolidated for that purpose. <Amended on August 19, 2015.>
(3) The term of office of an honorary head of Dong, Ri, Eup or Myeon shall be three years, and the person may be reappointed only once.
(4) Details necessary for the commissioning and duties of honorary heads of Dong, Ri, Eup and Myeon shall be determined by the Committee for the Five Northern Provinces under Article 7 of the Act. <Amended on August 19, 2015.>

Article 7 (Allowances)
Allowances may be paid, within budgetary limits, to honorary Mayors, heads of Gun, and honorary heads of Dong, Ri, Eup and Myeon.

Article 8 (Processing of Personally Identifying Information)
Where unavoidable for performing affairs concerning the commissioning of honorary Mayors, heads of Gun and honorary heads of Dong, Ri, Eup and Myeon under Articles 2 and 6, the Minister of the Interior and Safety and Governors may process data containing resident registration numbers or passport numbers under Article 19, subparagraph 1 or 2, of the Enforcement Decree of the Personal Information Protection Act. <Amended on July 26, 2017.>

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 10006, August 26, 1980>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Transitional Measures) Honorary Mayors, heads of Gun and honorary heads of Eup and Myeon commissioned before these Rules enter into force shall be deemed to have been commissioned under this Decree.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 19484, May 25, 2006>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Transitional Measures concerning the Terms of Office of Honorary Mayors and Heads of Gun Filling Vacancies) The term of office of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun commissioned to fill a vacancy as at the time this Decree enters into force shall expire on June 24, 2007.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Public Administration and Security and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20741, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (42) Omitted.

(43) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for Unrecovered Regions shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) and the main sentence of paragraph (3), "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of Public Administration and Security".

(44) through (105) Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 21727, September 15, 2009>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Security and Public Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24425, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Decrees.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (51) Omitted.

(52) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for Unrecovered Regions shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) and the main sentence of paragraph (3), "Minister of Public Administration and Security" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of Security and Public Administration".

(53) through (129) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 25751, November 19, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 5 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (158) Omitted.

(159) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for Unrecovered Regions shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) and the main sentence of paragraph (3), "Minister of Security and Public Administration" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs".

(160) through (418) Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 26498, August 19, 2015>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 28211, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 8 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Decrees.

Articles 2 through 7
Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (147) Omitted.

(148) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for the Five Northern Provinces and Unrecovered Si and Gun shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2), the main sentence of paragraph (3), and Article 8, "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of the Interior and Safety".

(149) through (388) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 473 Statutes and Regulations to Improve Difficult Legal Terminology) <Presidential Decree No. 31380, January 5, 2021>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Establishment of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of a Global City for Future Industries) <Presidential Decree No. 34550, June 4, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on June 8, 2024.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (23) Omitted.

(24) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for the Five Northern Provinces and Unrecovered Si and Gun shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2), "Governor of Gangwon-do" shall be replaced with "Governor of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province".

(25) through (44) Omitted.
